name: Asia Pioneer Entertainment Holdings Ltd.
summary: Asia Pioneer Entertainment Holdings Limited, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Macau, is an investment holding company supplying electronic gaming equipment in Macau, Taiwan, the Philippines, Korea, China, Malaysia, Cambodia, Hong Kong and elsewhere. Its EGE business sources, distributes, installs and repairs gaming equipment such as electronic table games and slot machines, with consultancy services. Its Smart VM business operates and leases smart vending machines, including franchised coffee vending under the KATFFEE brand.
